title: The Irish Rover
commons_title: File:Irish Rover - Celtic Aire - United States Air Force Band.mp3
composition: traditional Irish song, early 19th century; public domain
credit: Performance by Celtic Aire, United States Air Force Band (a work of the US Government, public domain).
lyrics: In the year of our Lord eighteen hundred and six
We set sail from the coal quay of Cork
We were sailing away with a cargo of bricks
For the grand city hall in New York
We'd an elegant craft, she was rigged fore and aft
And oh, how the trade winds drove her
She had twenty-three masts and she stood several blasts
And they called her the Irish Rover
